svg.title: In two years the share of enterprises using AI rose in all three size classes
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: In two years the share of enterprises using AI rose in all three size classes: in 2023: 10–49 employees: 6.4%, 50–249 employees: 13.1%, 250+ employees: 30.5%; in 2025: 10–49 employees: 17.0%, 50–249 employees: 30.4%, 250+ employees: 55.0%.
